senses.gloss: कौप a. (f. पी) Relating or belonging to a well (as water).
कौप a. (f. पी) Relating or belonging to a well (as water).

कौपीन n. 1. The pudenda; 2. a privity, a privy part; 3. a small piece of cloth worn over the privities; 4. a ragged garment, कौपीनं शतखंडजर्जरतरं कंथा पुनस्तादृशी Bhartr.iii.101; 5. a wrong or improper act, sin.
